summary: Handcrafted displacement hulls, asymmetric fish, and performance twin fins shaped deliberate for Atlantic swells and cold-water wayfarers. Crafted with bio-epoxy resins, sustainable cedar stringers, and hand-tuned hydrodynamics.

competencies.description: Continuous belly contours, rolled displacement entries, spiral vee exits, and tailored rail volumes tuned specifically for punchy beach breaks and long peeling point breaks.
Double 4oz & 6oz S-glass cloth, single-batch opaque resin pigments, acid swirl marble laminations, and mirror gloss polish hand-finished in our dust-free curing bay.
SuperSap plant-derived epoxy matrices, recycled high-density EPS cores, sustainably harvested Pacific red cedar stringers, and organic linen deck reinforcements.

roles.title: Master Shaper & Studio Director
highlights: Engineered proprietary displacement hull contours yielding 30% higher trim speed in cold-water Atlantic swell regimes.
Formulated zero-VOC bio-resin glassing standards now adopted across regional artisan shaping collectives.
Delivered over 450 custom shapes to surfers across Long Island, New England, California, and France.

roles.title: Head Lamination Specialist
highlights: Pioneered custom resin-tint layering, multi-tone acid swirls, and high-tensile volan cloth reinforcements.
Trained junior glassers and managed production output for East Coast custom shapers.
Implemented closed-loop acetone recycling reducing workshop chemical waste by over 60%.

roles.title: Apprentice Shaper & Fin Foiler
highlights: Hand-foiled custom marine plywood keel fins and glass-on flex fins from raw fiberglass blanks.
Milled and planed rough blanks, master rocker jigs, and template cutting under master craftsmen.

patent.title: Hydrodynamic Variable-Rocker Rails with Dual Asymmetric Release
patent.summary: Asymmetric rail foil design permitting high-speed hold on backside bottom turns while releasing cavitation freely on frontside cutbacks.

customBlocks.quote: A great surfboard is not merely an object of utility—it is an instrument of harmony between human intent and the living geometry of the ocean.
